hook.name: AutoCompoundBurnHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 vault hook that consolidates all pool liquidity into a single full-range position, automatically compounding 80% of LP fees back into the position and distributing 10% each to two fixed payout recipients (e.g., buy-and-burn contracts). Pool creation is restricted to authorized addresses; each swap triggers TWAP-validated automatic fee collection and compounding.
